title: Non-deterministic interleaving fuzzer and golden-seed suite for streaming tool + structured-output compatibility
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Interleaved streaming responses + concurrent tool/function calls expose non-deterministic race conditions across model shims, SDK buffering, and downstream parsers. These issues cause intermittent schema violations, partial JSON blobs, and flakey e2e test failures in CI. Existing golden prompt suites target deterministic sequences but do not exercise randomized interleavings or KV cache prefix states.

Objective: Build a reproducible fuzzing and golden-seed harness that simulates real-world interleaving (partial chunk boundaries, tool call shocks, mid-stream schema toggles) and produces a small set of stable, reviewable 'golden seeds' for CI regression. The harness should integrate into the CI pipeline, surface behavioral diffs as reproducible artifacts, and provide quick triage info (serialized trace, seed, model shim config).

Scope: Streaming + function/tool calling + structured output (ndjson/JSONL/partial JSON) across hosted and dedicated runtime variants. Focus on API-level blackbox tests (client<->endpoint) with the ability to run model shims locally for deeper root-cause investigation.
tasks: Design fuzzer state machine: token/chunk boundaries, tool-call injection points, KV-prefix states
Implement deterministic RNG-backed seed runner with replay mode and trace serialization
Create 2000 randomized seeds, run stability filtering to select ~50 reproducible failures and ~20 stable golden seeds
Add structured-output validators (NDJSON line integrity, schema conformance, partial-object recovery heuristics)
Integrate harness with existing regression infra and add a nightly job that runs against hosted + dedicated smoke models
Expose failing seed artifacts (trace, request/response stream, model shim diff) to CI UI and Slack alerting channel
Document triage playbook and add runbook links in failure attachments
acceptance_criteria: Fuzzer can replay any seed deterministically and produce identical byte-for-byte traces when run with same RNG and model-shim config
Selected golden seeds are stable across 10 runs on both hosted and dedicated smoke hardware (<=1% flake rate)
CI job marks regressions and attaches replay artifacts (seed id, trace, minimal repro) to the failing build
At least 20 golden seeds cover combinations of (stream split, mid-stream tool invocation, schema-rollback, kv-prefix-hit)
On a seeded failure, triage runbook yields a likely root-cause classification (client-buf, runtime-emit, model-variant) in automated summary
test_plan: Unit tests for RNG/replay determinism (1000 fixed seeds, assert identical traces)
Property tests for schema validators using mutational fuzzing of golden outputs
Cross-variant CI runs: nightly against hosted-api-prod-smoke, dedicated-reserved-smoke, and local model-shim dev environment
Adversarial run: inject artificial network jitter and chunk coalescing to validate buffer reassembly
Manual review: PM/Design review of 20 candidate golden seeds to ensure they represent realistic user workflows
ci_changes: Add pipeline job 'compat-fuzzer-nightly' to CircleCI with matrix: [hosted, dedicated]
Store failure artifacts in artifact store at s3://redwood-ci/compat-fuzzer/{date}/{seed_id}/
Add gating rule: any new test flake rate >5% for golden seeds opens a blocker ticket and notifies #platform-regressions
Expose a small web UI endpoint for replaying seeds from CI artifacts and streaming live traces for triage
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Fuzzer produces too many low-value failures and overwhelms triage. Mitigation: stability filtering and manual labeling step to promote golden seeds only after PM/Eng sign-off
Risk: Nightly CI increases costs on dedicated pools. Mitigation: restrict dedicated runs to smoke model and run heavy fuzzing off-hours on ephemeral infra
Risk: Non-reproducible failures due to seed/PRNG mismatches. Mitigation: embed exact runtime/version metadata and use fixed-seed replay mode in artifacts
